name: Bog-Leech
effect: Attacks drain 12% of damage dealt as health and apply slow.
desc: Siphons vitality with every blow while weighing down boots in phantom mire.

name: Iron-Bulwark
effect: +45% physical armor and frontal shield block chance.
desc: Encased in thick riveted plate that turns aside glancing melee strikes.

name: Cinder-Veined
effect: Melee hits deal bonus fire damage and leave burning ground.
desc: Molten cracks across its hide scorch the earth beneath every footstep.

name: Brine-Soaked
effect: High cold resistance; chills attackers on melee contact.
desc: Drenched in freezing sea-water that numbs sword-arms on impact.

name: Storm-Charged
effect: Emits periodic lightning bolts toward nearby armored targets.
desc: Crackling static arcs violently from its weapon toward heavy metal.

name: Marrow-Rot
effect: Aura reduces enemy healing received by 40% within 4 tiles.
desc: Exhales grave-damp miasma that curdles salves and dulls healing wards.

name: Ash-Shrouded
effect: +30% ranged evasion and leaves blinding smoke when struck.
desc: Swirling soot obscures its outline, confounding archers at long range.

name: Debt-Collector
effect: Deals +25% damage to targets below 50% health.
desc: Presses the attack ruthlessly whenever a defender begins to falter.

name: Thorn-Carapace
effect: Reflects 18% of melee physical damage back to the attacker.
desc: Jagged iron spurs jut from its armor, punishing reckless close strikes.

name: Quick-Stepping
effect: +35% movement speed and immune to root or snare effects.
desc: Darts across broken terrain without breaking stride or losing momentum.

name: Hex-Warded
effect: +40% elemental resistances and cleanses debuffs every 8 seconds.
desc: Inscribed wards flare across its skin, burning off hostile curses.

name: Skull-Splitter
effect: Critical hits stun the target for 1.5 seconds.
desc: Delivers crushing overhead blows meant to rattle helms and break formations.

name: Grave-Caller
effect: Raises fallen lesser foes nearby as brittle skeletons.
desc: Mutters forbidden parish litanies that drag slain comrades back upright.

name: Alkali-Crusted
effect: Explodes in caustic salt-dust on death, blinding nearby foes.
desc: Hardened salt-crusts shatter upon death in a stinging white cloud.

name: Windlass-Eyed
effect: +30% ranged accuracy, range, and armor penetration.
desc: Picks out tiny gaps in breastplates with cold, unhurried precision.

name: War-Drummer
effect: Allies within 5 tiles gain +20% attack speed and morale.
desc: Drives nearby raiders into a relentless frenzy with grim battle-cadence.

name: Bell-Toller
effect: Periodically silences casters within 4 tiles for 2 seconds.
desc: A corroded funeral chime disrupts chants and scatters arcane focus.

name: Slag-Blooded
effect: Bleeds molten slag when hit, damaging adjacent melee fighters.
desc: Every open wound spills white-hot embers across the boots of attackers.

name: Tide-Sworn
effect: Regenerates 3% max health per second while standing in water or mud.
desc: Draws cold vigor from shallow surf, stagnant fens, and rain-slick stone.

name: Oath-Chained
effect: Splits 30% of incoming damage with nearby lesser allies.
desc: Bound by iron pacts that force subordinates to absorb lethal blows.

name: Lantern-Eater
effect: Drains 8 mana per hit and gains temporary ward strength.
desc: Feeds on ambient aether, starving mages while thickening its own shell.

name: Pit-Hound
effect: Fixates on the lowest-armor target and leaps past frontliners.
desc: Ignores heavy shields to lunge straight at archers and wounded healers.

name: Frost-Locked
effect: Every fourth attack freezes the target solid for 1.5 seconds.
desc: Rime creeps along its blade until steel locks joints in brittle ice.

name: Tallow-Burned
effect: Leaves trails of slick grease that ignite when struck by fire.
desc: Reeks of rendered fat that turns skirmish lines into sudden infernos.

name: Iron-Lunged
effect: Immune to poison, bleed, and suffocating ash-cloud effects.
desc: Breathes sulfur and swamp-gas without slowing a single heartbeat.

name: Shield-Breaker
effect: Attacks sunder target armor by 3 per hit, stacking 5 times.
desc: Hooks shield-rims and dents breastplates with heavy, methodical force.

name: Mirage-Veiled
effect: Spawns two fragile decoys at 50% health.
desc: Heat-shimmer splits its silhouette into flickering false targets.

name: Venom-Gland
effect: Attacks apply stacking poison that deals damage over 6 seconds.
desc: Bitter green ichor coats every fang and blade edge.

name: Obsidian-Plated
effect: Negates the first 25 damage of every incoming physical hit.
desc: Volcanic glass scales turn aside light cuts and weak arrow volleys.

name: Ember-Herald
effect: Calls down delayed cinder-strikes on stationary targets.
desc: Marks ground beneath rooted defenders before raining burning ash.

name: Cold-Notary
effect: Curses attackers with +20% cooldown duration on active skills.
desc: Binds combatants in spectral red tape that slows every counterstrike.

name: Berserk-Scar
effect: Gains +50% damage and +25% attack speed below 35% health.
desc: Fresh wounds only strip away caution and double its ferocity.

name: Copper-Grounded
effect: Immune to lightning and redirects arcs to the nearest foe.
desc: Braided copper wires channel stray bolts harmlessly into the dirt.

name: Mire-Treader
effect: Summons grasping bog-roots beneath ranged attackers every 10 seconds.
desc: Commands tangled fen-vines to pin backline archers in place.

name: Grim-Standard
effect: Prevents nearby allies from fleeing until the bearer falls.
desc: Carries a tattered war-banner nailed to bone that steadies cowards.

name: Void-Gazing
effect: Teleports behind the furthest caster every 12 seconds.
desc: Steps through dark folds in the air to ambush unguarded backlines.

name: Caldera-Heart
effect: Pulses fire waves every 6 seconds and resists 50% fire damage.
desc: A furnace burns inside its ribs, venting searing waves across the melee.

name: Blood-Tithe
effect: Heals 15% max health whenever any unit dies within 6 tiles.
desc: Drinks spilled vitality from friend and foe alike on crowded fields.

name: First-Seal
effect: Immune to stun, knockback, and displacement abilities.
desc: Anchored by ancient Threshold wards that refuse to budge an inch.

name: Ashen-Sovereign
effect: Combines fire aura, armor sunder, and heavy summon reinforcement.
desc: An apex champion of the Ember Court capable of breaking unprepared companies.
